The '''DP-23 Rifle''' was a type of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], [[Pletus Croix]] gave one to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], for helping him with a number of tasks. The stock was similar to that of the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A]].
